ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals ENVIRONMENT.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

17. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

18. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Home ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Home ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Home ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Home ENVIRONMENT.
